decision: Architecture regen was a human card but is fully automatable (deterministic, no creds, cwd=repo_root). Operator hit 'NO SYSTEM MAP YET' on quantre-migration: root cause = (1) regen run in DontPanic repo not the scoped project, (2) DontPanic not a registered project, (3) serve watcher ignores architecture.json. Fix = make refresh automatic. Operator chose 'cache-only for display + hook commits': the build regenerates a missing/stale map into the dashboard CACHE only (F001, shipped) so the tracked repo working tree is never dirtied by a DP build; the committed copy stays fresh via an auto-installed pre-commit hook (F003). F002 adds architecture.json to the serve watch. Existing test test_build_emits_view_state_even_when_architecture_missing asserted the OLD absent-state behavior; updated to the self-heal contract (fresh map, not 'absent → run regen') — spec-clarification, not a regression.
